item.title: This animation shows what doom-scrolling does to your brain

item.title: ICE can demand your data from Google without a warrant
item.description: If you attend a protest and post about it on Instagram, federal agents may already have a way to find out who you are. The Department of Homeland Security has administrative subpoena power — meaning it can demand records from tech companies, schools, and individuals without a judge's approval, without proving probable cause, and without notifying the person being surveilled. — Read the rest The post ICE can demand your data from Google without a warrant appeared first on Boing Boing.

item.title: A terrifying weapon is being used to save lives in Ukraine
item.description: One of the most surprising things to come out of the war in Ukraine has been the rapid adoption of drones by both sides.
